raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With the ROCm 7.2 torch wheel (`lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261025`, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2), DeepSeek-V4.1 TP4 target verify returns a wrong wo_a output at 289-294 rows on MI355X, on every layer (relative error 1.4 against an fp32 reference). DSpark verifies 6 rows per request, so a 49-request verify batch hits it. The DSpark draft takes the same route.

`_wo_a_bf16_bmm_token_major` (#46176) has hipBLASLt write the bmm straight into the token-major layout through a strided `out=`. The hipBLASLt bundled with that wheel picks a stream-K kernel at these row counts that miscomputes the strided destination; the same GEMM writing a packed result (the einsum) is exact. The ROCm 10 build of the same day (`v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261025`, torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, HIP 7.15) is exact at every row count, so the change applies before HIP 7.15 only (`_STRIDED_BMM_OUT_OK`, the gate #45193 uses).

## Modifications

Before HIP 7.15, TP4 verify rows 9-384 go through `_hip.wo_a_verify_matmul`:

- MXFP8 wo_b (the gfx950 default): the packed einsum plus one fp8-grid quant launch over both groups, written straight into wo_b's token-major fp8 + ue8m0. This replaces the strided bmm plus wo_b's own quant with the same traffic and launch count. `_launch_fp8_grid_quant` also takes a `[M, G, K / G]` input read through its strides; 2-D callers keep their tiles and addresses.
- bf16 wo_b and the DSpark draft: the einsum copied token-major at the 6 broken rows only (`_WO_A_VERIFY_STRIDED_BMM_BAD_ROWS`, the measured failure set); main's strided bmm everywhere else.
- CUDA, HIP prefill and HIP >= 7.15 are unchanged. `test_deepseek_v4_amd_wo_a_bf16.py`: the bf16 verify graph test also runs 292 rows, and a new graph test covers the MXFP8 hand-off at 64 and 292 rows.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X, `_apply_wo_a_bf16_matmul` with 2 groups (TP4) followed by a real MXFP8 wo_b. Every verify row count 1-384, 3 `o` layouts (dense, strided, 64-head padded), 2 passes per image (2 seeds, 2 GPUs):

| path | image | wrong rows, main | wrong rows, this PR |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| verify, MXFP8 wo_b | ROCm 7.2 | 289-294 (each layout) | 0 |
| verify, bf16 wo_b / DSpark draft | ROCm 7.2 | 289-294 (each layout) | 0 |
| verify, MXFP8 wo_b | ROCm 10 | 0 | 0 |
| verify, bf16 wo_b / DSpark draft | ROCm 10 | 0 | 0 |
| prefill 4096-65536 (main's code, 33 sampled row counts) | both | 0 | 0 |

Wrong means a relative error > 1e-2 against wo_b's output on the einsum (main's wrong rows are at 1.41). On ROCm 7.2 the hand-off's fp8 codes equal wo_b's own quant of the correct bf16 at every row, and wo_b's output is bitwise equal to it at every row, so it equals main's wherever main is right. The scale byte of an all-zero 32-group differs (its codes are 0 either way), as in #45193. The bf16 route differs from main only at 289-294. On ROCm 10 both routes equal main bitwise at every row. `test_deepseek_v4_amd_wo_a_bf16.py` passes on both images (8/8); on main its two 292-row cases fail on ROCm 7.2.

## Speed Tests

MI355X x1, ROCm 7.2 image, CUDA-graph replay (median of 21 rounds, mean of 2 GPUs), us per layer. MXFP8 wo_b: wo_a + quant + wo_b's GEMM; bf16 wo_b: wo_a.

| rows | MXFP8, main | MXFP8, this PR | per 40-layer step | bf16, main | bf16, this PR | per 40-layer step |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 9 | 12.91 | 12.79 | -0.005 ms | 6.36 | 6.36 | 0 |
| 54 | 22.22 | 22.25 | +0.001 ms | 14.40 | 14.40 | 0 |
| 128 | 25.26 | 25.20 | -0.002 ms | 14.11 | 14.10 | 0 |
| 192 | 27.40 | 27.27 | -0.005 ms | 16.05 | 16.05 | 0 |
| 256 | 29.02 | 28.82 | -0.008 ms | 15.75 | 15.77 | +0.001 ms |
| 288 | 30.10 | 29.89 | -0.008 ms | 16.00 | 16.00 | 0 |
| 289-294 (main wrong) | 32.60-32.87 | 32.85-33.01 | +0.002 to +0.010 ms | 20.16-20.93 | 24.36-24.85 | +0.16 to +0.18 ms |
| 384 | 31.54 | 31.32 | -0.009 ms | 16.65 | 16.65 | 0 |

Every row 9-384 was also timed on 2 more GPUs: outside 289-294 the MXFP8 path is within -0.30 / +0.15 us of main (mean -0.08 us) and the bf16 path within ±0.04 us. Prefill runs main's code (4096 / 16384 / 65536 rows: 58.8 / 188.9 / 733.5 us main, 58.8 / 188.7 / 733.2 us this PR). On ROCm 10 the hook returns before any work, so the kernels are main's (measured within ±0.15 us per layer).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

     M,

+    group_k,
     stride_xm,

     stride_om,
     stride_sm,
     BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
     BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
     EMIT_FP8: tl.constexpr,
 ):
     """Per-32 ue8m0 fp8 e4m3 quantization, one program per [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K]: the fp8
-    codes and ue8m0 exponents with EMIT_FP8, else their dequantized values."""
+    codes and ue8m0 exponents with EMIT_FP8, else their dequantized values. x's columns
+    come in groups of group_k, group g at x_ptr + g * stride_xg."""
     pid_m = tl.program_id(0)
     pid_k = tl.program_id(1)
     offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
     offs_k = pid_k * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    g = pid_k * BLOCK_K // group_k
     m_mask = offs_m < M
     x = tl.load(
-        x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_xm + offs_k[None, :],
+        x_ptr
+        + g * stride_xg
+        + offs_m[:, None] * stride_xm
+        + (offs_k - g * group_k)[None, :],
         mask=m_mask[:, None],
         other=0.0,
     ).to(tl.float32)

     Fp8GridActivation,
     Mxfp8Activation,

 )
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
@@ -255,3 +256,32 @@ def wo_a_fp8_grid_matmul(
     if fp8_grid:
         return Fp8GridActivation(y)
     return y.view(o.shape[0], wo_a.shape[0], wo_a.shape[1])
+
+
+# hipBLASLt before HIP 7.15 (ROCm 10) miscomputes a bmm into a strided out= at many shapes
+_STRIDED_BMM_OUT_OK = _is_hip and tuple(
+    int(v) for v in torch.version.hip.split(".")[:2]
+) >= (7, 15)
+
+# the measured failure set of the ROCm 7.2 torch wheel's hipBLASLt for the TP4 (2-group) verify
+# bmm into token-major bf16 (every row count 1-384 swept)
+_WO_A_VERIFY_STRIDED_BMM_BAD_ROWS = range(289, 295)
+
+
+def wo_a_verify_matmul(o: torch.Tensor, wo_a: torch.Tensor, emit_fp8: bool):
+    """TP4 target-verify wo_a before HIP 7.15. For an MXFP8 wo_b (emit_fp8): the einsum,
+    quantized in one launch over its group-major output into wo_b's token-major fp8 + ue8m0,
+    in place of the strided bmm plus wo_b's own quant. For a bf16 wo_b: the einsum copied
+    token-major at the rows the strided bmm gets wrong. None keeps the strided bmm."""
+    if _STRIDED_BMM_OUT_OK:
+        return None
+    if not emit_fp8:
+        if o.shape[0] in _WO_A_VERIFY_STRIDED_BMM_BAD_ROWS:
+            return torch.einsum("tgd,grd->tgr", o, wo_a).contiguous()
+        return None
+    y = torch.einsum("tgd,grd->tgr", o, wo_a)
+    T, G, R = y.shape
+    q = torch.empty((T, G * R), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=o.device)
+    scale = torch.empty((T, G * R // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device=o.device)
+    _launch_fp8_grid_quant(y, q, scale)
+    return Mxfp8Activation(q, scale)

 wo_a_fp8_grid_matmul = gfx95_dense.wo_a_fp8_grid_matmul

 wo_b_emits_mxfp8 = gfx95_dense.wo_b_emits_mxfp8

                             (error / ref.float().square().mean()).sqrt().item(), 1e-3
                         )
 
+    def test_verify_mxfp8_handoff_and_mutable_graph(self):

+        of the einsum (292: hipBLASLt's strided token-major bmm is wrong there), from 7.15
+        on the strided bmm's bf16."""
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.mxfp8_amd_gfx95 import (
+            Mxfp8Activation,
+            fp8_grid_quantize,
+        )
+
+        for rows in (64, 292):
+            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
+                x, w = self.operands(rows)
+                kwargs = dict(is_decode=False, is_target_verify=True, emit_fp8=True)
+                self.project(x, w, **kwargs)
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                    y = self.project(x, w, **kwargs)
+                for _ in range(2):

+                        continue
+                    q, scale = fp8_grid_quantize(ref.flatten(1))
+                    self.assertTrue(
+                        torch.equal(y.q.view(torch.uint8), q.view(torch.uint8))
+                    )
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(y.scale, scale))
+
     def test_dsv4_keeps_the_main_routes(self):
